info.title: Gridex Website and Partner Integration API
info.description: Canonical V1 contract for tenant context, public contracts, tenant-bound energy-area resolution, current normalized spot price, OPS-owned quote and website applications. public-contracts is a product feed, market-price/current is the current market interval, and quote is the complete customer calculation. Tenant backends never select company_id or calculate price, fees or VAT locally.

post.summary: Create a tenant-bound canonical quote for one published offer and one SE area
post.description: Scope: website_quotes.write. Freezes the exact published product/version, selected SE-area price, fees, VAT, assumptions, consumption and requested start date. One quote is consumed by at most one canonical customer application.

404.description: Published offer not found for tenant

422.description: Area price or quote input cannot be used

post.summary: Validate a canonical quote before customer application
post.description: Scope: website_quotes.validate. Verifies tenant, offer, customer type, SE area, grid area, postal code, annual consumption and requested start date. A quote already consumed by another application is rejected.

409.description: Quote already consumed or binding mismatch

422.description: Quote expired or no longer valid

post.summary: Create a customer application bound to a published offer
post.description: Scope: website_applications.write. Idempotency-Key krävs. Tenant härleds enbart från API-nyckeln. auth_user_id och customer_portal_user_id krävs som samma verifierade UUID. OPS committar canonical kund, kundnummer, site/mätpunkt, avtal, juridik, portalidentitet, workflow och ett beständigt customer_application_continuation-jobb. status=accepted betyder att denna beständiga commit är klar; e-post, anläggningsuppslag, leverantörsbyte och webhooks fortsätter asynkront och följs via statusendpointen.

200.description: Canonical graph and quote committed; all required idempotent post-commit evidence/workflow steps also completed and durable automatic processing queued

404.description: Refererad resurs finns inte inom verifierad tenant

409.description: Expired, consumed or mismatched quote/idempotency state

503.description: Temporärt beroendefel eller canonical resolution/workflow är inte tillgänglig

post.summary: Resolve canonical SE price area independently from grid-owner and EDIFACT readiness
post.description: Scope: website_energy_area.resolve. OPS evaluates full-address polygon/master evidence first and may use bounded postal/city candidate consensus as a pricing-only fallback. pricing_ready and quote_ready depend on price_area_assurance; facility lookup, switch creation and EDIFACT remain separately blocked until verified network context exists.

200.description: Resolution completed or requires a next action

postal_single_area_pricing_ready.summary: Postal/city consensus resolves SE3 for pricing but not EDIFACT

data.next_required_action: Verifiera föreslagen nätägare innan EDIFACT skickas.

switch_dispatch.message: Fullmakt, anläggning, aktuell leverantör, PRODAT-route och transportberedskap måste verifieras i kundflödet.

post.summary: Get the current normalized spot-price interval for a tenant-bound energy resolution
post.description: Scope: website_market_prices.read. resolution_id is authoritative for SE1-SE4. The response is the current wholesale market interval before VAT, supplier fees, energy tax and grid fees. It is not a complete customer price or settlement input.

legacyApiKeyAuth.description: Deprecated compatibility header. New integrations MUST use Authorization: Bearer <GRIDEX_API_KEY>. Sunset: 2026-10-31T23:59:59.000Z.

ErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical error envelope. Business and provider failures use one nested error object; no parallel top-level aliases are emitted.

tenant_reference.description: Stable opaque tenant identity. It is not the internal company UUID.

CustomerType.description: Canonical values. company is temporarily accepted as a deprecated alias for business until 2026-10-31.

id.description: Deprecated compatibility alias. Contains the same stable external value as offer_reference and never a database UUID.

contract_offer_id.description: Deprecated compatibility alias. Contains the same stable external value as offer_reference and never a database UUID.

publication_reference.description: Deprecated compatibility alias. Contains the same stable external value as offer_reference and never a database UUID.

area_pricing.description: Deprecated presentation-only area pricing. Use top-level price_options[].area_prices for canonical commercial selection.

legal_versions.description: Deprecated compatibility view of legal.module_versions. New clients must use legal.module_versions.

customer_type.description: company is a deprecated alias for business.

offer_reference.description: Canonical opak offer_reference. Måste skickas på top-level.

quote_reference.description: Obligatorisk canonical OPS-quote. Fältet ligger alltid på top-level; inget konfigurerbart referensplaceringsläge finns eller behövs.

price_area.description: Deprecated klientpåstående. OPS använder price_area från resolution_id och returnerar konflikt vid mismatch.

external_customer_reference.description: Alias for external_customer_id. Preserved while OPS assigns or reuses the canonical customer_number.

resolution_id.description: Samma tenantbundna OPS-resolution som användes när quote skapades. Fältet ligger alltid på top-level.

contract.description: Kompletterande start- och avtalsuppgifter. Lägg inte offer_reference, quote_reference eller resolution_id här.

CustomerApplicationRequest.description: Canonical kundansökan. offer_reference, quote_reference och resolution_id skickas exakt en gång på top-level. Ingen tenantkonfiguration eller quote-reference-mode används. När avtalet kräver fullmakt ska powerOfAttorney vara komplett och externally sendable.

PublicResourceId.description: Opaque, tenant-bound public resource identifier. It has no business meaning and must not be used outside the authenticated tenant context.

can_dispatch.description: Dispatch readiness is customer-specific and is never inferred from area resolution alone.

WebsiteCustomerApplicationData.description: Explicit public DTO. Internal price-plan, publication, portal-identity, provider-connection and contract-price-snapshot identifiers are never exposed.

WebsiteVisibilityMode.description: Presentation only. Hidden components remain available to the tenant calculation engine.

CalculationInclusion.description: Whether the component participates in the calculation. Independent of website visibility.

is_default.description: Canonical source of truth for whether this price option is the default.

default.description: Deprecated compatibility alias for is_default. Always identical to is_default.

customer_type.description: company is a deprecated alias for business.

resolution_id.description: Tenantbunden OPS-resolution. Dess price_area och grid_area_code är canonical.

WebsiteEnergyAreaResolution.description: Tenant-bound OPS resolution with independent price-area assurance and readiness for pricing, quote, facility lookup, switch creation and switch dispatch. A single-area postal consensus may allow pricing/quote while facility and EDIFACT actions remain blocked.

price_sek_per_kwh.description: Canonical market reference in SEK/kWh. May be negative.

price_ore_per_kwh.description: Canonical market reference in öre/kWh. Equals price_sek_per_kwh × 100 and may be negative.

source_as_of.description: Timestamp derived from the newest underlying provider evidence.

generated_at.description: Timestamp when the preview calculation was generated.

effective_stale_at.description: Minimum of the global preview limit and tenant max_age_minutes applied to source_as_of.

MarketReference.description: Self-contained market reference used by the OPS quote. preview is indicative and never final settlement evidence. requested_days and included_days expose window completeness. A partial fallback is returned only when tenant policy allows it.

signerIdentityNumber.description: Signerande persons identitet. Hanteras som skyddsvärd personuppgift.

PowerOfAttorneyInput.description: Strukturerad fullmakt som krävs för externally_sendable nätägarkommunikation. Bare consents.power_of_attorney=true är endast juridisk acceptans och kan inte skickas externt.

price_area.description: Optional assertion only. It cannot override the canonical area stored on resolution_id.

price_sek_per_kwh.description: Current spot price in SEK/kWh, excluding VAT and all supplier/grid fees.

price_ore_per_kwh.description: Current spot price in öre/kWh. Equals price_sek_per_kwh × 100.

price_ex_vat_sek_per_kwh.description: May be negative. Decimal value is returned without local tenant rounding.

price_ex_vat_ore_per_kwh.description: May be negative. Decimal value is returned without local tenant rounding.

fallback_used.description: The current interval endpoint never substitutes a historical or cross-area fallback.

MarketPriceErrorEnvelope.description: Canonical error envelope. Business and provider failures use one nested error object; no parallel top-level aliases are emitted.

EnergyDirection.description: Canonical economic direction. Consumption creates ordinary supply/invoice flows; production creates compensation settlement flows.

ProductionPricing.description: Explicit production compensation contract. Runtime currently supports fixed compensation; additional compensation models require a future contract-version bump.

ApiError.description: Canonical error envelope. Business and provider failures use one nested error object; no parallel top-level aliases are emitted.

legal_bundle_version_id.description: Immutable legal bundle version locked into the publication snapshot. The property is always present; historical explicitly approved exceptions may be null.

ErrorResponse.description: Canonical error envelope. Business and provider failures use one nested error object; no parallel top-level aliases are emitted.

PriceAreaAssurance.description: Canonical evidence used only to decide whether SE1-SE4 is safe for pricing and quote. This object never proves facility, grid-owner, PRODAT or EDIFACT readiness.

Forbidden.description: Scope missing or tenant access denied

TenantGone.description: Tenant is terminated and no longer serves external API traffic

TenantPaused.description: Tenant is paused and external API traffic is temporarily locked

InternalError.description: The canonical API contract feed could not be built

Conflict.description: Expired, consumed or mismatched quote/idempotency state

GridexContractVersion.description: Canonical contract version used for this response.

RequestId.description: Stable request identifier for support and audit.

ETag.description: Strong entity tag for conditional retrieval.

Vary.description: Request headers that affect cache validation.

customer_portal.read.replacement: Grant the granular read scopes required by the routes used.

customer_portal.write.replacement: Grant the granular write scopes required by the routes used.

post.description: This callback URL is hosted by the tenant, not by app.gridex.se. Gridex signs the exact raw request body with HMAC-SHA256 over `${timestamp}.${rawBody}`. Verify timestamp freshness and X-Gridex-Signature, then deduplicate X-Gridex-Event-Id and X-Gridex-Delivery-Id before returning any 2xx response. Non-2xx responses enter the documented retry and dead-letter pipeline.

2XX.description: Event accepted and durably deduplicated by the tenant receiver.

post.description: Sent after every durable customer-application workflow transition. The tenant must verify the HMAC signature, deduplicate event and delivery headers, persist the event, and return 2xx. Non-2xx responses enter the retry and dead-letter pipeline.

2XX.description: Event accepted and durably deduplicated by the tenant receiver.

post.description: Sent for every switch- or supply-related customer-application workflow transition. The event is tenant-scoped, durably queued, idempotent, signed, retried, and dead-lettered on terminal delivery failure.

2XX.description: Event accepted and durably deduplicated by the tenant receiver.
